notes: Day 18 continues (Theophilus ends at doxology ¶20; arke follows; then new commemoration of St Romanus the monk, martyr under Diocletian's governor Asqlatyanos: ወበዛቲ ዕለት / በዚችም ቀን). Arke is Ge'ez only, full width. Numerals ፲፰-፳፬ INFERRED from sequence after p071 ¶፲፯ (print numerals tiny/dotted; doxology numbered as paragraph like p064). ¶፳፬ cut off at bottom of page in both columns: Ge'ez ends "ለእመ፡" (next word on p073), Amharic ends "እንሰ" (mid-word, next letters on p073, join with no space). Ge'ez uncertain: ወሐሊተ (¶፲፰), ኵሎሙ (print reads ኮሎሜ/ኮሎሙ; Amharic says "ሁሉ"), አሙ አሐተኔ (¶፳፪, unclear: maybe እሙንቱ/አምሐተኔ), ይበቁዓኒ (print ይበቍዓኒ-like), arke "የነትም" (maybe ያኅትም), ተሀሉ.
